editorial_review.scope: All 25 verses, source and translation reread; reviewed lexical relations and grammatical groups.
notes: Gen 2:10: 'become four heads' is absorbed in the French 'se divisait en quatre bras'.
Gen 2:16–17: infinitive absolute constructions are attached to the finite verb expression; no invented extra French lexical equivalent.
Gen 2:22–23: directional and demonstrative morphology in the French reordered construction is contextual.
Gen 2:25: verbal idiom 'avoir honte' is linked to the original verb with discontinuous tokens.
